newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-BECKER PULLS OUT OF FRENCH OPEN. [CORRECTED 17:10 GMT]
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-BECKER PULLS OUT OF FRENCH OPEN. [CORRECTED 17:10 GMT]

text.p: Boris Becker has pulled out of the French Open tennis championships through injury, organisers said on Monday.
The three-times Wimbledon champion, ranked 12th in the world rankings, will be replaced in the men's draw by Italian Andrea Gaudenzi.
Organisers did not say what injury forced Becker to pull out of the French Open starting at Roland Garros next Monday.
The German has been hampered by a lingering wrist injury, and has played only three tournaments in the past three months, in Monte Carlo, Hamburg and the Italian Open.
(Corrects to make clear Becker has played in three tournaments in the last three months, not two tournaments).
Becker has yet to win a tournament on clay, and his best performance at Roland Garros was reaching the semifinals three times.
